SELECT u.id, u.username, u.nickname, u.email, u.status, u.last_login_time, u.create_time FROM sys_user u WHERE u.deleted = 0
AND (u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR u.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%'))
AND u.status = #{q.status}
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role ur WHERE ur.user_id = u.id AND ur.role_id = #{q.roleId} )
ORDER BY u.id DESC
SELECT DISTINCT r.role_code FROM sys_user_role ur INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status = 1 AND r.deleted = 0
